headlines.title: 美财长贝森特称 霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性
headlines.summary: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特日前在接受美国亚利桑那州地方电视台采访时说，随着地缘政治局势变化，今后越来越多能源运输将绕过霍尔木兹海峡。他认为，霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性。鉴于伊朗试图控制这条咽喉要道，海峡将无法回到过去的状态。在接下来两年时间里，海峡将变成一片普通水域，逐步变得不再那么重要。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent says Strait of Hormuz will gradually lose strategic importance
headlines.summary_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a recent interview with a local Arizona TV station that as geopolitical conditions shift, more energy shipments will bypass the Strait of Hormuz in the future. He believes the strait will gradually lose its strategic importance. Given Iran's attempts to control this chokepoint, the strait will not return to its previous state. Over the next two years, it will become an ordinary waterway, steadily diminishing in importance. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 北京证监局：加力服务新质生产力 持续助力首都资本市场高质量发展
headlines.summary: 【北京证监局：加力服务新质生产力 持续助力首都资本市场高质量发展】北京证监局召开2026年北京辖区辅导机构监管交流会。北京证监局分管负责同志传达证监会党的建设暨监管工作座谈会精神，通报辖区辅导监管工作开展情况，交流辅导工作新思路、新理念，并提出工作要求。中国证券业协会有关负责人围绕如何进一步提高发行辅导工作质量作出指导，并介绍协会自律监管下一步工作考虑。22家辅导机构相关负责同志参加会议，部分辅导机构结合各自工作开展情况作分享交流。

headlines.title_en: Beijing CSRC Bureau: Intensify efforts to serve new quality productive forces, continuously support high-quality development of the capital's capital market
headlines.summary_en: [Beijing CSRC Bureau: Intensify efforts to serve new quality productive forces, continue supporting high-quality development of the capital market] The Beijing CSRC Bureau held the 2026 Beijing district sponsor institution regulatory exchange meeting. The responsible official conveyed the spirit of the CSRC's Party building and regulatory work symposium, reported on the district's sponsor supervision progress, exchanged new ideas and concepts on sponsorship work, and raised work requirements. A relevant China Securities Association official guided how to further improve issuance sponsorship quality and introduced the association's next steps for self-regulatory supervision. Representatives from 22 sponsor institutions attended, with some sharing experiences based on their own work.

headlines.title: 经济学家：通胀已是关乎美联储信誉的问题
headlines.summary: 阿波罗全球管理公司首席经济学家托尔斯滕·斯洛克表示：“目前通胀已经不限于经济问题，而是关乎美联储的信誉。自2021年以来，通胀一直高于目标水平。对于世界头号央行而言，高通胀持续的时间非常、非常久。”

headlines.title_en: Economists: Inflation is now a credibility issue for the Fed
headlines.summary_en: Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management, said: 'Inflation is no longer just an economic issue—it's about the Fed's credibility. Inflation has been above target since 2021. For the world's top central bank, that's a very, very long time for inflation to stay elevated.'

headlines.title: 国家统计局：7月份居民消费价格指数（CPI）同比上涨0.5%
headlines.summary: 【国家统计局：7月份居民消费价格指数（CPI）同比上涨0.5%】2026年7月份，全国居民消费价格同比上涨0.5%。其中，城市上涨0.5%，农村上涨0.4%；食品价格下降1.5%，非食品价格上涨0.9%；消费品价格上涨0.2%，服务价格上涨0.7%。1—7月平均，全国居民消费价格比上年同期上涨0.9%。7月份，全国工业生产者出厂价格同比上涨3.5%，环比下降0.7%。工业生产者购进价格同比上涨5.5%，环比下降1.0%。1—7月平均，工业生产者出厂价格比上年同期上涨1.8%，工业生产者购进价格上涨2.8%。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: CPI up 0.5% year-on-year in July
headlines.summary_en: 【National Bureau of Statistics: July CPI up 0.5% year-on-year】In July 2026, the national consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.5% year-on-year. Urban areas rose 0.5%, rural areas rose 0.4%; food prices fell 1.5%, non-food prices rose 0.9%; consumer goods prices rose 0.2%, and service prices rose 0.7%. On average from January to July, national consumer prices rose 0.9% year-on-year. In July, the national producer price index (PPI) for factory gate prices rose 3.5% year-on-year and fell 0.7% month-on-month. Producer purchase prices rose 5.5% year-on-year and fell 1.0% month-on-month. On average from January to July, factory gate prices rose 1.8% year-on-year, and producer purchase prices rose 2.8%.

headlines.title_en: Everbright Securities: Market may continue to rebound in short term; focus on three performance主线
headlines.summary_en: 【Everbright Securities: Market may continue to rebound short-term, focus on three earnings lines】Everbright Securities research report believes that the market may continue to rebound short-term, focusing on three earnings lines. Recent overseas stock markets, especially the semiconductor sector, have gradually stabilized and recovered, which has a positive effect on the stabilization of A-share tech sectors. The August semi-annual report disclosure period is expected to become the turning point from valuation digestion to earnings-driven growth, and the earnings season is likely to be the best allocation window for the second half of the year. In terms of allocation, it is recommended to focus on three earnings lines. First, tech hardware (semiconductors/AI computing power/storage), the strongest direction of earnings improvement this round; second, the price increase chain (nonferrous metals/chemicals/coal), directly benefiting from PPI recovery with high certainty of earnings realization;

headlines.title: 景林资产二季度大幅减持热门科技股
headlines.summary: 当地时间8月7日，知名千亿级私募景林资产披露2026年二季度末最新美股持仓（13F）。二季度，景林资产清仓英伟达、META等热门科技股，大幅减持英特尔、网易、谷歌等标的；景林资产在二季度末的美股持仓市值从38.8亿美元大幅下降至21.9亿美元，降幅达43%。在大幅收缩多只原有持仓的同时，景林资产也对部分半导体产业链公司进行了布局，包括近期业绩超预期的美国光模块制造商AAOI（应用光电）。（中国证券报）

headlines.title_en: Greenwoods Asset Management significantly reduces holdings in popular tech stocks in Q2
headlines.summary_en: On August 7 local time, renowned private equity firm Greenwoods Asset Management disclosed its latest U.S. equity holdings (13F) as of the end of Q2 2026. During the quarter, Greenwoods fully exited popular tech stocks including Nvidia and Meta, and significantly trimmed positions in Intel, NetEase, Google, among others. Its U.S. equity holdings market value dropped sharply from $3.88 billion to $2.19 billion at quarter-end, a decline of 43%. While sharply reducing multiple existing holdings, Greenwoods also built positions in some semiconductor supply chain companies, including U.S. optical module maker Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI), which recently beat earnings expectations. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 生物制造驶入发展快车道 产业资本密集布局
headlines.summary: 近期生物制造赛道产业与资本动作密集。多家初创企业相继完成新一轮融资，华润双鹤、鲁抗医药等上市公司持续加大布局力度，产业落地节奏显著提速。业内人士认为，生物制造行业正处于从技术创新向产业应用加速转化的关键期。在技术突破、政策支持和资本涌入的多重驱动下，行业有望在未来5—10年实现规模化发展，成为全球制造业绿色转型的重要引擎。中国凭借完备的发酵产业基础和持续的政策支持，有望在全球生物制造竞争中占据重要地位。 (中证报)

headlines.title_en: Biomanufacturing enters fast-track development, with industrial capital deploying densely
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the biomanufacturing sector has seen intensive industry and capital activity. Several startups have completed new financing rounds, while listed companies such as China Resources Double Crane and Lukang Pharmaceutical continue to step up their investments, with industrial deployment accelerating notably. Industry insiders believe biomanufacturing is in a critical period of accelerating transformation from technological innovation to industrial application. Driven by technological breakthroughs, policy support, and capital inflows, the industry is expected to achieve scaled development in the next 5-10 years, becoming an important engine for green transformation of global manufacturing. Leveraging its complete fermentation industry base and sustained policy support, China is well-positioned to occupy an important place in global biomanufacturing competition. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 中国稀土：2026年半年度净利润同比增长46.53%
headlines.summary: 8月7日，中国稀土发布2026年半年度报告，实现营业收入16.47亿元，同比下降12.19%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润2.37亿元，同比增长46.53%。报告期内，稀土行业供需格局持续调整优化，受稀土产业政策、下游市场需求提振等多重有利因素影响，市场行情整体上行，镨钕产品价格较去年同期涨幅明显。（新京报）

headlines.title_en: China Rare Earth: 2026 interim net profit up 46.53% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: On August 7, China Rare Earth released its 2026 semi-annual report, posting operating revenue of 1.647 billion yuan, down 12.19% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of listed companies was 237 million yuan, up 46.53% year-on-year. During the reporting period, supply-demand dynamics in the rare earth industry continued to adjust and optimize. Driven by multiple favorable factors such as rare earth industry policies and downstream market demand, the overall market trended upward, with praseodymium-neodymium product prices rising markedly versus the same period last year. (Beijing News)

headlines.title: 贷款利率定价基准“换锚” 利率市场化再进一步
headlines.summary: 近期，多家商业银行落地以DR（存款类金融机构间债券回购利率）为定价基准的企业贷款，标志着我国贷款利率定价基准多元化的探索提速。专家表示，持续丰富贷款定价参考基准，构建多元化基准利率体系，既是稳步推进利率市场化改革的重要举措，也有助于提升货币政策传导效能，更好地服务实体经济各类经营主体。 (中证报)

headlines.title_en: Loan pricing benchmark shifts anchor, further advancing interest rate marketization
headlines.summary_en: Recently, several commercial banks have issued corporate loans priced on DR (deposit institution bond repurchase rate), marking accelerated exploration of diversified loan pricing benchmarks in China. Experts say that continuously enriching loan pricing reference benchmarks and building a diversified benchmark rate system is both an important step in steadily advancing interest rate marketization reform and helps improve the effectiveness of monetary policy transmission, better serving diverse entities in the real economy. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 公募股权变更再添一例，万联证券拿下长安基金控股权
headlines.summary: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特日前在接受美国亚利桑那州地方电视台采访时说，随着地缘政治局势变化，今后越来越多能源运输将绕过霍尔木兹海峡。他认为，霍尔木兹海峡将逐步失去战略重要性。鉴于伊朗试图控制这条咽喉要道，海峡将无法回到过去的状态。在接下来两年时间里，海峡将变成一片普通水域，逐步变得不再那么重要。（新华社）

headlines.title: 美国两年期国债收益率在非农日跌5个基点，本周累跌约9.6个基点
headlines.summary: 周五（8月7日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率跌3.24个基点，报4.6454%，北京时间20:30发布美国非农就业报告时从4.6678%跳水、20:47刷新日低至4.6007%，本周累计下跌8.93%，8月4日跌幅突出。 两年期美债收益率跌5.02个基点，报4.1952%，非农就业报告出炉时从4.2306%跳水、20:40刷新日低至4.1515%，本周累跌9.59个基点。

headlines.title_en: U.S. 2-year Treasury yield falls 5 bps on payrolls day, down ~9.6 bps for the week
headlines.summary_en: At the New York close on Friday (August 7), the US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield fell 3.24 basis points to 4.6454%. When the US nonfarm payroll report was released at 20:30 Beijing time, it plunged from 4.6678%, hitting a session low of 4.6007% at 20:47. It fell 8.93% for the week, with August 4 seeing a notable decline. The 2-year Treasury yield dropped 5.02 basis points to 4.1952%, plunging from 4.2306% when the payroll report was released, and hitting a session low of 4.1515% at 20:40. It was down 9.59 basis points for the week.

headlines.title: 上海国投先导参与投资智微凌峰基金
headlines.summary: 近日，上海国投先导公示对上海智微凌峰创业投资合伙企业（有限合伙）的投资。该基金由智微资本担任管理人，目标规模30亿元。LP阵容汇聚中微公司、澜起科技等半导体龙头的旗下平台，工业X射线检测领域企业日联科技的子公司，以及地方国资平台，形成“产业资本+国有资本”的深度联合。智微凌峰基金以半导体设备、零部件、材料及先进封装等集成电路核心环节为主攻方向，重点挖掘“卡脖子”领域的“隐形冠军”。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai Guotou Leading participates in investment in Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund
headlines.summary_en: Recently, Shanghai Guotou Pilot disclosed its investment in Shanghai Zhiwei Lingfeng Venture Capital Partnership (Limited Partnership). The fund, managed by Zhiwei Capital, has a target size of 3 billion yuan. Its LP lineup brings together platforms under semiconductor leaders including AMEC and Montage Technology, a subsidiary of industrial X-ray inspection firm Nuctech, as well as local state-owned capital platforms, forming a deep alliance of 'industrial capital + state capital.' Zhiwei Lingfeng Fund focuses on core integrated circuit segments such as semiconductor equipment, components, materials, and advanced packaging, with an emphasis on uncovering 'hidden champions' in 'bottleneck' areas.

headlines.title: 出口禁令驱动有色板块大涨，机构认为情绪冲击难持续 刚果（金）出口禁令消息虽短期催化 A 股有色板块大涨，但机构与龙头企业普遍认为该禁令实质影响有限且行情难持续。不过，国际铜价则因供应扰动及库存低位等因素被多家投行看多。

headlines.title_en: Export ban drives nonferrous metals sector surge; institutions say sentiment shock unlikely to last. While news of DRC export ban briefly catalyzed a sharp rally in A-share nonferrous metals, institutions and leading firms generally believe the ban's actual impact is limited and the rally is unsustainable. However, international copper prices are being viewed bullishly by multiple investment banks due to supply disruptions and low inventory levels.
